From a box of paper to one tidy file

The paperwork doesn't change — the awarding body's forms stay exactly as they are. What changes is how long it takes, and how much goes missing.

Paper

  • Registers copied up after the course
  • Assessment checklists ticked on a clipboard
  • Exam papers posted, scanned or lost
  • Feedback forms collected, then counted by hand
  • Evenings spent building the file for the IQA

Digital Training Centre

  • Photograph the register — names are read in automatically
  • Tick competencies on the iPad as the course runs
  • Photograph exam papers — filed against each learner
  • Learners scan a QR code and give feedback on their phone
  • One tap for the full course pack, ready for review

Everything a course needs, from the register to the IQA sign-off.

See the features

Everything a course needs, from the first learner to the IQA sign-off

One app for the trainer in the room, and a clear view for the people who check the work afterwards.

Deliver

Run a consistent course, whoever is teaching it.

Practical scenarios
Briefs, role-player cards, safety checks and debriefs, so every trainer runs the same scenario the same way.
Scene soundscapes
A live sound mixer that turns a quiet classroom into a busy street, a workshop or an incident scene.
Skills stations
Tap-to-mark competency grids, built around the awarding body's own criteria.

Capture

Paper still has a place. It just doesn't have to stay paper.

Photo capture
Registers, exam papers and signed forms photographed and filed against the right learner, in the right order.
QR feedback
Learners scan a code, answer on their phone, and their responses fill in the official feedback form.
QR quizzes
Quick knowledge checks through the day, answered on learners' phones with live class results.

Assure

The evidence your quality team asks for, already assembled.

Complete course packs
Cover sheet, register, assessment record, exam papers and feedback, as one continuous PDF.
Awarding body forms
Official record sheets filled in digitally, with the trainer's signature, and the form left exactly as issued.
IQA review
Trainers submit their pack; reviewers open it, record the outcome and leave actions in one place.

Manage

A view across every course and every trainer.

Admin portal
Search every course by learner, trainer, date or venue, and see what's outstanding at a glance.
Instructor CPD logs
Teaching and assessing hours logged automatically from the courses delivered, ready to download.
Works offline
No signal in the training hall? The app keeps going and saves when the connection returns.

Built by trainers, run to UK standards

Designed with working emergency care and rescue instructors, and already used to deliver accredited training.

UK data, properly protected

Course records stored in the UK, encrypted, with individual logins and role-based access. Registered with the Information Commissioner's Office.

Your awarding body's forms

We complete the official documents rather than replacing them, so your evidence stays recognisable to quality assurers.

Works on the kit you have

Runs in the browser on iPads, tablets and laptops. No app store installs. Managed iPad kits available.

How a course runs

The same four steps, whether it's a one-day refresher or a five-day qualification.

Set up the course

Pick the course, add the trainers, and photograph the register to bring the learners in.

Deliver and assess

Run scenarios and skills stations, marking competencies as learners achieve them.

Capture the paperwork

Photograph exam papers and let learners give feedback by QR code before they leave.

Submit the pack

Sign, build the course pack and submit it for review — often before you've packed the kit away.

Your paperwork, made digital

Every organisation has its own forms — in-house assessments, induction checklists, risk assessments, sign-off sheets. Send us what you use today and we'll build it into your own version of the Digital Training Centre, with your branding, your courses and your process.
